projects.name: CC-Copilot Bridge
projects.description: Route Claude Code between Anthropic, GitHub Copilot, and local Ollama models.
projects.use_when: You need to change the model provider behind a Claude Code workflow.

relations.label: Run with
relations.reason: yt-insights already detects the bridge as its preferred LLM backend.

relations.label: Observe with
relations.reason: monitor Claude Code sessions while the bridge handles provider routing.

relations.label: Optimize with
relations.reason: the bridge optimizes provider choice while RTK reduces command-output noise.

relations.label: Learn with
relations.reason: compare gateways, model choices, and cost trade-offs.

projects.name: claude-code-plugins
projects.description: Install focused Claude Code plugins built from reusable guide templates.
projects.use_when: You want packaged skills, hooks, agents, and workflows instead of copying files manually.

relations.label: Learn with
relations.reason: the guide explains the decisions and trade-offs behind the installable templates.

relations.label: Observe with
relations.reason: the session-tools plugin already connects Claude Code workflows to CCBoard.

relations.label: Optimize with
relations.reason: the session-tools plugin already provides an RTK integration.

relations.label: Validate with
relations.reason: check that installed instructions remain aligned with the codebase.

projects.name: ctxharness
projects.description: Detect drift between code, instructions, and assembled agent context.
projects.use_when: You need evidence that CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and related context still match the repository.

relations.label: Learn with
relations.reason: connect the checks to the guide's context-engineering and harness practices.

relations.label: Use with
relations.reason: validate contexts and rules installed through the plugin collection.

relations.label: Secure with
relations.reason: combine documentation integrity with checks for documented campaigns and risky configuration.

projects.name: flow-lean
projects.description: Apply one lean-output rule to Claude Code responses.
projects.use_when: You want shorter action-first responses without stacking several overlapping skills.

relations.label: Measure with
relations.reason: verify that the skill is invoked in real transcripts rather than only mentioned.

relations.label: Optimize with
relations.reason: flow-lean reduces model prose while RTK reduces command output.

relations.label: Learn with
relations.reason: place response density inside the broader context-engineering model.

projects.name: RTK
projects.description: Compress development-command output before it enters an agent's context.
projects.use_when: Verbose Git, test, build, or infrastructure output consumes too much context.

relations.label: Use with
relations.reason: the session-tools plugin provides a ready-to-install integration.

relations.label: Optimize with
relations.reason: the two projects reduce different layers of the same context budget.

relations.label: Route with
relations.reason: combine context efficiency with explicit provider selection.

projects.name: CCBoard

relations.label: Search with

relations.label: Learn with

relations.label: Route with

projects.name: CC-Sessions
projects.description: Index and search local Claude Code session history.

relations.label: Visualize with

relations.label: Analyze with

relations.label: Learn with

projects.name: cc-skill-usage
